category: type label only: docs (security-policy near miss)
title: SECURITY.md: the PGP key expired on 2026-02-22
body:
The key in SECURITY.md (`AE96 ED96 9E47 9B00 84F3 E17F E88D 3334 FA5F 6A0A`, security@ / bounty@ethereum.org) expired on 2026-02-22:

```
pub   rsa4096 2016-11-11 [SC] [expired: 2026-02-22]
      AE96ED969E479B0084F3E17FE88D3334FA5F6A0A
uid           Ethereum Foundation Security Team <security@ethereum.org>
uid           Ethereum Foundation Bug Bounty <bounty@ethereum.org>
```

The copies on keyserver.ubuntu.com, pgp.mit.edu, and ethereum.org/security_at_ethereum.org.asc show the same expiry, so gpg warns anyone encrypting a report to it. Same thing as #24055 in 2021. Could the expiry be extended and the key block in SECURITY.md refreshed (and the ethereum.org copy)?
